purpose: Development sensitivity check of fixed sample selectors under numeric training contamination; not confirmatory thesis evidence
design: Three prespecified contamination draws per fold. Within a draw, 5% is a prefix of 10%; identical rows, columns and signs across methods. Clean fits performed once per fold/method.
numeric_rule: IQR from nonmissing clean training values using linear quantiles; exclude zero IQR columns. For each selected row choose uniformly among eligible observed numeric cells; error if none. Random sign +/- with equal probability. Add sign*10*IQR; no domain clipping.
test_rule: Original full development test fold unchanged. Adult official test reserved.
analysis: Paired F1 and AUC changes versus same-fold clean model; average draws within fold before fold summary. Fold SD descriptive only. No p-values, confidence intervals, or noninferiority claims.
